title: Two branch offices lose Teams sign-in; a long thread with a wrong first theory
scenario: A long ticket over five days. The customer's attention is on a new Conditional Access baseline, the engineer follows it despite a log lookup that shows nothing arriving, and only a user's remark about a lookup failure sends the work to name resolution, where a newly added filtering resolver is the cause.

events.title: Leith and Dalkeith cannot get into Teams
events.text:
Hello. Since Friday afternoon about 40 people across our Leith and Dalkeith branches can't sign in to Teams; Edinburgh head office is untouched. Some see a window with caa82ee7 on it, others only a spinner, and a handful get in after repeated tries. Possibly relevant: a new Conditional Access baseline went live on Thursday (MFA for everything, 4-hour sign-in frequency).

Fiona Rae, service desk lead, Marchmont Group

events.title: Ticket created
events.text: Ticket MG-20418 created. Priority P2. Next update due 11:00 UTC.

events.title: Re: Leith and Dalkeith cannot get into Teams
events.text:
Hi Fiona, thanks, that is a good start. Could you send: the text the failing ones actually see; names and approximate UTC times for any three affected people; and which branches, floors or networks are fine and which are broken? Also whatever else changed since Wednesday on the network, DNS, proxy or firewall side, however minor.

Hamish

events.title: Re: Leith and Dalkeith cannot get into Teams
events.text:
Fri: s.ferguson 14:12 UTC, a.mcleod 14:40; Mon: d.imrie 08:20. The caa82ee7 window is on s.ferguson's PC; the other two just spin. HQ is fine; Leith and Dalkeith aren't. Nobody has told me of any network change, but the branch network is run by a different team who don't always tell me.

Fiona

events.title: Entra lookup and CA audit
events.text: s.ferguson 14:12, a.mcleod 14:40 (Fri), d.imrie 08:20 (Mon), all UTC, +/- 5 min, interactive and non-interactive: no rows for any of them. CA audit: policy 'Baseline-v2' created Thu 17:20 UTC, MFA on all apps, sign-in frequency 4 h.

events.title: Where I am
events.text: Entra shows nothing for the three, so strictly these attempts never arrived. But the new CA baseline is the only recorded change since Wednesday, so I want it ruled out first by excluding a few users from it. Name resolution can wait.

events.title: Rule out the new policy
events.text:
Fiona, please have an admin exclude s.ferguson, a.mcleod and d.imrie from 'Baseline-v2' for now, and on d.imrie's PC also clear the Teams cache, then try signing in. Tell me what each of the three sees.

Hamish

events.title: Re: Rule out the new policy
events.text:
Excluded all three from Baseline-v2 at 11:40 UTC and cleared d.imrie's cache. Still failing for all three: s.ferguson gets the same caa82ee7 window, d.imrie and a.mcleod just spin.

Fiona

events.title: SLA notice
events.text: First-response target met. Next customer update due 13:00 UTC.

events.title: Client-side trace
events.text:
Thanks. Next I would like to see what the client itself does: please have two of the affected users capture a Fiddler or HAR trace of a failing sign-in, and zip the Teams log bundle (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+1 inside the app), and send them over.

Hamish

events.title: Re: Client-side trace
events.text:
Two of our people are trying the trace. Meanwhile it has spread: about 15 more people in Dalkeith are now reporting the same thing this afternoon.

Fiona

events.title: fiddler
events.text:
i tried the fiddler thing and it wants an admin password which i dont have. fiona said to tell you the page says DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN when it shows anything. sorry.

Ian, Dalkeith

events.title: Status change
events.text: Status changed from Open to Waiting on customer (client-side trace outstanding).

events.title: New direction: name resolution
events.text:
> fiona said to tell you the page says DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN when it shows anything

Fiona, a user's remark from yesterday (quoted above) changes my thinking: this looks like name resolution at the two branches rather than policy. Forget the trace. Please ask your branch network admin to resolve login.microsoftonline.com and the CDN host the sign-in page uses against every resolver that the Leith and Dalkeith DHCP scopes list, from a Leith PC, ten tries per resolver, and send me the raw answers. You can put the CA exclusions back as they were. I will chase this at 12:00 UTC.

Hamish

events.title: Re: New direction: name resolution
events.text:
OK. Our branch network admin Callum Reid is on leave until Thursday; his deputy Zofia Nowak will do it. Please bear with us. Also, can you tell me who at Microsoft I should talk to about the Teams errors?

Fiona

events.title: Follow-up reminder
events.text: Reminder: engineer follow-up due 12:00 UTC. No customer reply since Tue 09:55 UTC.

events.title: resolver tests from Leith
events.text:
Zofia (network, covering for Callum). From LTH-021 in Leith, 10 tries each:
10.80.1.2   login.microsoftonline.com  answered 10/10
10.80.1.3   login.microsoftonline.com  answered 10/10
10.80.9.10  login.microsoftonline.com  NXDOMAIN 10/10, the CDN name the same
10.80.9.10 is the CloudShield filtering resolver that Callum's team added to the Leith and Dalkeith scopes on Thursday evening. HQ doesn't use it.

events.title: That is the cause; workaround and fix
events.text:
Thank you Zofia, that is it: 10.80.9.10 fails for the Microsoft names while .2 and .3 answer. Workaround, now: remove 10.80.9.10 from the Leith and Dalkeith scopes and renew leases (a reboot does it). Permanent: the CloudShield admin amends the rule so Microsoft's published endpoint hostnames are never blocked, under your change control. I will look at reports until 17:30 UTC today and again tomorrow at 09:00.

Hamish

events.title: scope change done
events.text:
Removed 10.80.9.10 from the Leith and Dalkeith scopes at 16:05 UTC. Leith PCs have been told to reboot; Dalkeith closes at 16:00 so they will pick it up tomorrow morning.

Zofia

events.title: First word from Leith
events.text:
First word from Leith: people there are signing in again, no error windows so far. Dalkeith will reboot in the morning.

Fiona

events.title: SLA notice
events.text: Next update due Wed 09:00 UTC.

events.title: Dalkeith update
events.text:
Dalkeith rebooted first thing and all fifteen are in. Leith still fine. No new reports since yesterday 16:05 UTC.

Fiona

events.title: Check after the workaround
events.text:
Resolver test from LTH-021 and from a Dalkeith PC this morning: .2 and .3 answer, .9.10 still fails but is no longer handed out. No new contacts since Tue 16:05 UTC. The CloudShield rule fix is booked for Friday; keeping the case open until then.

Hamish

events.title: CloudShield's answer
events.text:
CloudShield's support says their 'newly registered domains' category wrongly caught the Microsoft CDN name. Their fix is a category exception, scheduled for Friday 09:30 UTC.

Fiona

events.title: Re: CloudShield's answer
events.text:
Understood. Once the exception is in, please put 10.80.9.10 back into one branch scope as a test and tell me how sign-in goes, so that we confirm the permanent fix.

Hamish

events.title: Exception in place
events.text:
CloudShield's exception has been in since 09:30 UTC. I put 10.80.9.10 back into the Leith scope at 10:00 as you asked: Leith PCs sign in fine, and Zofia's test from LTH-021 shows all three resolvers answering the Microsoft names.

Fiona

events.title: Before and after
events.text:
Before/after: from Monday to Tuesday afternoon there were new reports every hour from the two branches; since the scope change on Tuesday and the exception this morning, none. The resolver test is clean for all three resolvers. Good to close.

Hamish

events.title: Resolution
events.text: Resolution. Cause: the new CloudShield filtering resolver 10.80.9.10, added to the Leith and Dalkeith DHCP scopes on Thursday evening, mishandled the Microsoft sign-in and CDN names while the other two resolvers answered correctly. Workaround (Tue 16:05 UTC): resolver removed from the scopes. Permanent fix (Fri 09:30 UTC): category exception at CloudShield. The CA exclusions I asked for on Monday were a wrong turn and have been reverted.

events.title: Case closed
events.text: Status changed from Resolved to Closed.
